name: Jeribai
title: One of David's mighty warriors
summary: Jeribai was the son of Elhanan and is mentioned as one of David's mighty warriors in 1 Chronicles. He belonged to the extended list of heroes who served King David with bravery in battle. Although little is known about his individual deeds, his place among David's elite warriors was a great honor.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's heroes
keyEvents.description: Jeribai, the son of Elhanan, is listed in the register of David's mighty men who served him faithfully in battle.

keyEvents.title: Service under King David
keyEvents.description: As one of David's chosen warriors, Jeribai participated in the defense and expansion of David's kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Part of the elite group of warriors
keyEvents.description: Jeribai belonged to the extended circle of David's heroes beyond the thirty most famous, which testifies to his bravery and loyalty.

keyEvents.title: The assembly of David's mighty men
keyEvents.description: The list of David's mighty men shows how God gathered brave warriors around David to establish his kingdom over Israel.
